blocks.text: Technology par mabni hal banate waqt Pakistan ki mukhtalif saqafaton, riwayat aur aqdar ka khayal rakhna zaroori hai. Applications sab ko shamil karne wali, qabil-e-rasai aur maqami rasm-o-riwaj ka ehtram karne wali hon. Maslan AI systems aisi zaban aur mawad use karein jo ilaqai tanawwo aur samaji hassasiyat ko zahir kare.

Nayi technology mein hamesha akhlaqi zimmedari ko tarjeeh honi chahiye. Data ka ghalat istemal, privacy mein dakhal, ya saqafati tor par na-munasib mawad bad-aitmadi paida kar ke bastiyon ko nuqsan pohancha sakta hai. Talaba aisi applications banayein jo insaf, ehtram aur musbat samaji asar ko farogh dein, taake technology tarakki ki musbat taqat rahe.

blocks.title: Tidbit
blocks.text: Technology tab kamyab hoti hai jab woh maqami riwayat, aqaid aur users ki zarooraton ka ehtram kare.

blocks.prompt: Technology par mabni hal banate waqt kin teen cheezon se bachna chahiye jo bharosa torti hain?
blocks.explanation: Data ka ghalat istemal, privacy mein dakhal (invasion of privacy) aur saqafati tor par na-munasib content.

items: Applications inclusive, accessible aur maqami riwayat ka ehtram karne wali hon.
Nayi ijaad mein akhlaqi zimmedari pehle.
